capabilities: hide files not modified for a set number of days
unhide files automatically when they are opened
hide folders whose files are all cold
temporarily reveal hidden files at reduced opacity
exclude folders and glob patterns from hiding
disambiguation: Not a privacy or security tool; 'hiding' only removes files from the file explorer view, and hidden files stay accessible via search, links, and the quick switcher.
extras: Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; before marketplace approval it must be installed via BRAT or git clone.
problem: A long-lived vault accumulates many stale files in the file explorer, burying active work with no automatic way to keep inactive ones out of sight.
summary: File explorer cleaner that automatically hides files untouched for a set number of days and un-hides them when you open them again.
